title: Drag Couenne wins Drag Race Belgique Season 1
summary: In the Grande Finale (BE-S01-E08), Athena Sorgelikis and Drag Couenne lip-synced to Angèle ft. Damso's "Démons". Drag Couenne was crowned the winner of the first season of Drag Race Belgique; Athena Sorgelikis finished as runner-up. Susan placed third.

title: Brittany Von Bottoks: Belgium's first Porkchop
summary: Brittany Von Bottoks was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Belgique (BE-S01-E01), lip-syncing to Stromae's "Tous les mêmes" against Amanda Tears.
